Computer Science.title: UX Engineer
Computer Science.summary: Build the interactive interface of a product so design intent becomes working, accessible software.

Computer Science.title: Frontend Engineer
Computer Science.summary: Implement the parts of a web application that people see and interact with in the browser.

Computer Science.title: Backend Engineer
Computer Science.summary: Build the servers, APIs, and data logic that power an application's features behind the scenes.

Computer Science.title: UX Researcher
Computer Science.summary: Study how people use products and turn those findings into evidence for design and engineering decisions.

Computer Science.title: Product Manager
Computer Science.summary: Set a product's goals and priorities, then align engineering and design work to deliver them.

Computer Science.title: Data Scientist
Computer Science.summary: Analyze large datasets with statistics and machine learning to answer questions and guide decisions.
